text:
jamal: Heads up — offer for Sr ML Eng (A. Patel). Hiring manager is asking for $240k base which is $25k above our published band top. Need comp-exception routing + sign-off + start-date coordination. Candidate has a counteroffer deadline this Friday. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mira: Yep — reason is senior infra expertise + specific LLM runtime experience. Candidate is fielding multiple offers, counter expires Friday. Ideally start Apr 15. Can we fast-track? :pray:
lucy: Looping in comp @chris. jamal, can you paste the full proposed package (base, sign-on, equity, relocation) so we can route?
jamal: Proposed package:
```
base: $240,000
sign-on: $30,000 (prorated over 12 months)
equity: 0.35% (4yr, 1y cliff)
relocation: $10,000 lump sum
expected start: 2026-04-15 (flex +/- 1 week)
notes: candidate has 2 weeks notice but willing to negotiate start.
```
chris: Quick math: band top = $215k, proposed = $240k -> delta $25k (~11.6% above band). I can approve up to 10% above band for retention/market reasons; anything >10% needs VP People sign-off. Need a short justification to route.
mira: Justification bullets (copyable):
- Candidate brings 6+ years infra + LLM runtime experience and a track record shipping low-latency production systems.
- Market benchmarks show comp for similar roles at competitor comps 8-15% above our band.
- Candidate has a competing written offer expiring 2026-03-26 (end of week).
- Critical hire for our infra roadmap (low-latency KV caching feature) — delayed hire risks timeline slip for Q2.
jamal: Pasting justification into the approval request now.
hr-bot: Approval request submitted to @sophia for comp-exception (reason: MARKET_COUNTER). Request ID: AR-2026-01173. Routing: chris -> sophia. ETA for decision: 48 hours.
chris: Adding one note — recommend sign-on be paid 50% at start + 50% at 6 months to aid retention.
lucy: Agreed. @sophia, any chance we can expedite given candidate deadline? Short approval + comment would help. :eyes:
sophia (VP People): Reviewed justification and bench data. Approve one-time exception to base up to $240,000 (12% above band) given competing offer and criticality. Sign-on $30k approved as proposed; relocation approved. Please mark as "one-time market exception" and include candidate-specific retention clause (6mo pro-rata).
chris: Noted — I'll update Comp tool and append exception code MARKET_COUNTER_2026_03. Inform payroll/finance for special sign-on schedule.
jamal: Sending offer letter now using template: https://redwood.docs/offers/template-v2 (include exception block).
lucy: Please cc people-ops@redwood on the outbound offer. Also set start-date tentative Apr 15 and include standard new-hire onboarding checklist link.
jamal: Offer sent at 15:24 PT. Candidate accepted verbally, requested official signed offer within 24h.
hr-bot: Offer status updated: SENT -> ACCEPTED_VERBAL. Offer record AR-2026-01173 updated.
sophia (VP People): Thanks team — please finalize paperwork and welcome packet.
chris: I'll run the comp change and notify finance.
jamal: Will upload signed doc and close requisition once accepted.
lucy: Closing loop here — great cross-team turnaround. :tada:
